notes: idTech3-derived (IW/Treyarch) engine: RCON is the Quake3 connectionless UDP form, a single datagram of 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF followed by 'rcon <password> <command>' sent to the game port - NOT the Valve Source RCON wire protocol, hence flavour 'custom'. There is no separate RCON port or enable switch: the server listens on net_port (default 28960) and RCON is live as soon as rcon_password is set in server.cfg. Command text here is what goes after the password; typed from a game client it is prefixed '/rcon '. Commands are case-insensitive (hosting docs write 'banClient', B3 writes 'banclient'); lowercase chosen to match the B3 cod5 parser. Moderation identifier is the client slot number from 'status' (column 'num'), which is what clientkick and banclient take; BigBrotherBot's Cod5Parser uses exactly 'clientkick %(cid)s' and 'banclient %(cid)s'. Name-based variants exist ('kick <name>', 'banuser <name>', 'onlykick <name>') but need the exact name including colour codes and are unreliable, so they are not recorded. Stock CoD5 clientkick/banclient take no reason or duration argument (B3's q3a base class passes a reason but the CoD parser deliberately overrides it away), so no {reason}/{duration} tokens. unban is deliberately omitted: the only live unban is 'unbanuser <exact player name>', which cannot be expressed with a client-number playerId. banclient writes the player's numeric GUID to a ban.txt created in the main or fs_game directory (documented for CoD4 patch 1.4; the same engine lineage, but the path and line format were not confirmed for World at War specifically, so no banList block is recorded rather than guessing one). No message-of-the-day command was found in any source, so motd is omitted. 'status' output starts with a 'map: <name>' line, a column header and a dashed rule - skipLinePattern drops all three; the linePattern is the B3 CodParser._regPlayer expression rewritten with named groups, with accountId mapped to the numeric CoD GUID column. Sources agree on every recorded command; the only inconsistency between them is casing.
